lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCuAg adopts the tetragonal I-4m2 space group (No. 119), with a cell formula of Mg2Cu2Ag2 and a reduced formula of MgCuAg, containing six atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: Ag and Cu each have eight geometric neighbors (4 Cu/4 Mg or 4 Ag/4 Mg), while Mg has eight neighbors (4 Ag/4 Cu), with all neighbor distances near 2.78 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ag- and Cu-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Mg-centered polyhedra.
